hooks.command: unset BASH_ENV ; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-almanac-write.sh" ; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0 ; exec env -u SHELLOPTS bash "$f"
unset BASH_ENV ; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-tasks-tool.sh" ; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0 ; bash -n "$f" 2>/dev/null || exit 0 ; exec env -u SHELLOPTS bash "$f"

unset BASH_ENV ; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/reminder-chart-tasklist.pl" ; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0 ; H="${ALMANAC_HOME:-${HOME:-$USERPROFILE}}" ; [ -n "$H" ] || exit 0 ; case "$H" in /*|[A-Za-z]:/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac ; IFS= read -r -N 8388608 -t 10 P ; [ -n "$P" ] || exit 0 ; [[ $P =~ \"hook_event_name\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"PostToolUse\" ]] || exit 0 ; [[ $P =~ \"agent_id\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"[^\"]*\" ]] && exit 0 ; if [[ $P =~ \"session_id\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\" ]] ; then SID="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" ; else exit 0 ; fi ; D="$H/.claude/almanac-state/chart-reminder/$SID.t" ; [ -d "$D" ] || { mkdir -p "$D" 2>/dev/null || exit 0 ; } ; [ -d "$D" ] || exit 0 ; WM=0 ; read -r WM 2>/dev/null < "$D/.watermark" || WM=0 ; [[ $WM =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || WM=0 ; MAX=0 ; for t in "$D"/* ; do b="${t##*/}" ; [[ $b =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue ; (( b > MAX )) && MAX=$b ; done ; BASE=$MAX ; (( WM > BASE )) && BASE=$WM ; N=0 ; i=1 ; while (( i <= 1000 )) ; do cand=$(( BASE + i )) ; set -C ; : > "$D/$cand" 2>/dev/null ; ok=$? ; set +C ; if [ "$ok" -eq 0 ] ; then N=$cand ; break ; fi ; i=$(( i + 1 )) ; done ; [ "$N" -gt 0 ] || exit 0 ; (( N % 20 == 0 )) || exit 0 ; exec env -u SHELLOPTS perl "$f" "$N" "$SID" <<< "$P" ; exit 0
